== Biography ==

The Pigeon is a large, anxious bird of Wonderland convinced that Alice is a serpent. Upon encountering her, it attacks violently, beating her with its wings and screaming accusations. Despite Alice's firm denials, the Pigeon remains unconvinced, speaking instead of the deeper problem that consumes it—a persistent serpent trouble that no amount of searching through tree roots, banks, or hedges has been able to solve.
